source: SHAPE America (2017). National Standards for Initial Physical Education Teacher Education.

standards.title: Content and Foundational Knowledge
standards.description: Physical education candidates demonstrate an understanding of common and specialized content, and scientific and theoretical foundations for the delivery of an effective preK-12 physical education program.

standards.title: Skillfulness and Health-Related Fitness
standards.description: Physical education candidates are physically literate individuals who can demonstrate skillful performance in physical education content areas and health-enhancing levels of fitness.

standards.title: Planning and Implementation
standards.description: Physical education candidates apply content and foundational knowledge to plan and implement developmentally appropriate learning experiences aligned with local, state and/or SHAPE America's National Standards and Grade-Level Outcomes for K-12 Physical Education through the effective use of resources, accommodations and/or modifications, technology and metacognitive strategies to address the diverse needs of all students.

standards.title: Instructional Delivery and Management
standards.description: Physical education candidates engage students in meaningful learning experiences through effective use of pedagogical skills. They use communication, feedback, technology, and instructional and managerial skills to enhance student learning.

standards.title: Assessment of Student Learning
standards.description: Physical education candidates select and implement appropriate assessments to monitor students' progress and guide decision making related to instruction and learning.

standards.title: Professional Responsibility
standards.description: Physical education candidates demonstrate behaviors essential to becoming effective professionals. They exhibit professional ethics and culturally competent practices; seek opportunities for continued professional development; and demonstrate knowledge of promotion/advocacy strategies for physical education and expanded physical activity opportunities that support the development of physically literate individuals.

components.label: Common content knowledge
components.text: Describe and apply common content knowledge for teaching preK-12 physical education.

components.label: Specialized content knowledge
components.text: Describe and apply specialized content knowledge for teaching preK-12 physical education.

components.label: Physiological & biomechanical concepts
components.text: Describe and apply physiological and biomechanical concepts related to skillful movement, physical activity and fitness for preK-12 students.

components.label: Motor learning & behavior change
components.text: Describe and apply motor learning and behavior-change/psychological principles related to skillful movement, physical activity and fitness for preK-12 students.

components.label: Motor development
components.text: Describe and apply motor development theory and principles related to fundamental motor skills, skillful movement, physical activity and fitness for preK-12 students.

components.label: Historical, philosophical & social perspectives
components.text: Describe the historical, philosophical and social perspectives of physical education issues and legislation.

components.label: Motor skill competency & content areas
components.text: Demonstrate competency in all fundamental motor skills, as well as skillful performance in a minimum of four physical education content areas (e.g., games and sports, aquatics, dance and rhythmic activities, fitness activities, outdoor pursuits, individual-performance activities).

components.label: Health-enhancing fitness
components.text: Achieve and maintain a health-enhancing level of fitness throughout the program.

components.label: Aligned short- & long-term objectives
components.text: Plan and implement appropriate (e.g., measureable, developmentally appropriate, performance-based) short- and long-term plan objectives that are aligned with local, state and/or SHAPE America's National Standards and Grade-Level Outcomes for K-12 Physical Education.

components.label: Progressive, sequential content
components.text: Plan and implement progressive and sequential content that aligns with short- and long-term plan objectives and that addresses the diverse needs of all students.

components.label: Resources & equitable experiences
components.text: Plan for and manage resources to provide active, fair and equitable learning experiences.

components.label: Individualized instruction & accommodations
components.text: Plan and implement individualized instruction for diverse student needs, adding specific accommodations and/or modifications for all students.

components.label: Technology in learning experiences
components.text: Plan and implement learning experiences that require students to use technology appropriately in meeting one or more short- and long-term plan objective(s).

components.label: Metacognitive strategies
components.text: Plan and implement learning experiences that engage students in using metacognitive strategies appropriately to analyze their own performance results.

components.label: Respectful communication
components.text: Demonstrate verbal and nonverbal communication skills that convey respect and sensitivity across all learning experiences.

components.label: Demonstrations, explanations & cues
components.text: Implement demonstrations, explanations and instructional cues that are aligned with short- and long-term plan objectives.

components.label: Adjusting instruction
components.text: Evaluate the changing dynamics of the learning environment and adjust instructional tasks as needed to further student progress.

components.label: Routines & behavior management
components.text: Implement transitions, routines and positive behavior management to create and maintain a safe, supportive and engaging learning environment.

components.label: Skill analysis & feedback
components.text: Analyze motor skills and performance concepts through multiple means (e.g., visual observation, technology) in order to provide specific, congruent feedback to enhance student learning.

components.label: Authentic, formal assessments
components.text: Select or create authentic, formal assessments that measure student attainment of short- and long-term objectives.

components.label: Formative & summative assessment
components.text: Implement formative assessments that monitor student learning before and throughout the long-term plan, as well as summative assessments that evaluate student learning upon completion of the long-term plan.

components.label: Reflective cycle
components.text: Implement a reflective cycle to guide decision making specific to candidate performance, student learning, and short- and long-term plan objectives.

components.label: Professional ethics & cultural competence
components.text: Engage in behavior that reflects professional ethics, practice and cultural competence.

components.label: Professional growth & collaboration
components.text: Engage in continued professional growth and collaboration in schools and/or professional organizations.

components.label: Promotion & advocacy
components.text: Describe strategies, including the use of technology, for the promotion and advocacy of physical education and expanded physical activity opportunities.
